camera_make.description: Camera make for export metadata. Used when the paper has no valid EXIF make.

camera_model.description: Camera model for export metadata when missing from the paper EXIF.

camera_lens.description: Lens model for export metadata when missing from the paper EXIF. Use ink_softness in the ink group to soften strokes.

camera_iso.description: ISO for export metadata when missing from the paper EXIF. Ink appearance is controlled by the ink group.

latin_font.description: Default: follow the main font for ASCII letters, with fallback for missing glyphs. Leave unset unless the user asks for a separate English hand or dislikes the lettering. In an existing draft, omitting this key keeps its current value; null clears the override.

latin_font_scale.description: Size of ASCII letters relative to the main font, also applies to digits when latin_digits is true. Reset to 100 for an unscaled sample.

latin_digits.description: Leave unset on new drafts. False keeps 0–9 at the main font and size. True applies the Latin size and any selected Latin font to digits.

illustration_uses_pen.description: Render embedded diagram strokes and labels using the manuscript ink color, opacity, thickness and softness. The shapes and lettering in the source image stay as drawn.

transparent_background.description: Ink-only PNG preview and ZIP. PDF retains the paper.

ink_alpha.description: Alpha channel of the selected RGBA pen color, before ink opacity.

photo_ink_light.description: Requires a paper projection (automatic or from paper_guides). At 0 use the chosen pen RGB. At 100 multiply each projected ink channel by the original paper pixel, preserving local shade and colored rulings. Pure black stays black. Compare native crops against photographed marks. For edges that appear too harsh, inspect opacity and focus; brightness alone does not establish exposure.

photo_ink_focus.description: Requires a paper projection (automatic or from paper_guides). Soften only new ink (including equations, tables, graphs and illustration outlines) in photo pixels. Give from/to anchors {x,y,sigma_px}; x,y are normalized 0..1; sigma_px is 0..2. Match observed near/far focus and keep the sharp end at zero. Null removes the finish.

perturb_theta_sigma.description: Variation in glyph tilt. For a slightly hurried hand keep the font and seed; try increasing the current value by 0.02 rad, then preview the same line and check digits, units and alignment. perturb_x_sigma and perturb_y_sigma vary position in paper-space pixels.

strikethrough_probability.description: For requested occasional corrections: randomly insert a crossed-out extra character before the intended text when monospaced=false. Try 0.005 for a sparse sample; a short page may have none. Compare the same line with only probability changed; confirm a visible crossed-out character before reporting one. Check reflow and numbers. For a looser hand alone, leave this unchanged. Exact placement on a chosen word is unsupported; Markdown ~~text~~ is stripped to text.
